title: Diagnose seeded SOL close eligibility
commands_run: read-only SQLite inspection of SOL position_lots and seed action rows
read-only raw prepare_strategy_step/include_raw diagnostic for SOL/USDT:USDT

actual_scanner.reporting_note: Scanner top-level eligible_lots is stale/wrong for NO_ACTION because batch lot_profit_context was built with decision side '-' and filtered out both SOL lots.

cause.explanation: Seed-created SOL lots are included, symbol normalization works, and current price is fresh. The strategy engine sees one eligible LONG lot, but then blocks CLOSE because winner_profitable_close uses aggregate LONG leg profitability. The aggregate SOL LONG leg is deeply negative due older exposure, so AUTO_CLOSE_LOSS_FORBIDDEN_LONG suppresses the lot-level profitable seed close. A secondary scanner reporting issue hides the eligible lot after NO_ACTION.

minimal_change: When lot_trim_ready is true and eligible_lots_df has the chosen side, treat winner_profitable_close as true from eligible lot evidence instead of aggregate leg UPNL.
Keep AUTO_CLOSE_LOSS_FORBIDDEN for leg-target closes without eligible lot proof.
For scanner/batch reporting, compute lot_profit_context with side=None when decision side is missing or '-'.
tests: seeded LONG lot with current price above target and aggregate LONG leg negative -> CLOSE_LIMIT LONG
seeded SHORT lot with current price below target and aggregate SHORT leg negative -> CLOSE_LIMIT SHORT
seeded LONG below target -> NO_ACTION or existing open logic
seed lots included only if status=OPEN and exchange_confirmed/open fill confirmed
SOL/USDT:USDT aliases include SOL_USDT and SOL/USDT
scanner top-level target_reached_lots uses all sides when decision is NO_ACTION

summary: Read-only diagnosis found seeded SOL LONG lot is recognized and target-reached, but strategy blocks close because aggregate LONG leg UPNL is negative. This is not seed exclusion, stale price, symbol mismatch, target comparison, or policy close block. Minimal fix should let eligible exchange-confirmed lot evidence override aggregate leg loss guard for LOT_TRIM only, while preserving loss guard for leg-level closes.
